summary: This is an 8-K filed by Hyperion DeFi, Inc. reporting a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 2,777,778 shares of common stock at $3.60 per share. The underwriter is Chardan Capital Markets, LLC, purchasing at $3.384 per share. A 30-day option for up to 416,666 additional shares exists. Net proceeds are ~$8.7M (~$10.1M if option exercised). The offering is conducted under an effective shelf registration statement (Form S-3). Close is expected May 7, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No strategic change, acquisition, or restructuring is involved.
